subject: general
question: The sensation of feeling full is because of a centre associated with hunger, which is in a separate part of the ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Forebrain**__.

__
 
• The front brain is associated with the feeling of the satisfaction of hunger.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The brain is the central information processing organ of our body, and acts as the 'command and control system'.
 
• It controls the voluntary movements, the balance of the body, functional of vital involuntary organs (e.g., lungs, heart, kidneys, etc.), thermoregulation, hunger and thirst, circadian (24-hour) rhythms of our body, activities of several endocrine glands, and human behaviour.
 
• There are four lobes in the human brain-
 
 
• Frontal lobe.
 
• Parietal lobe.
 
• Occipital lobe.
 
• Temporal lobe.
 
 
 
• 
 
Frontal lobe

 
 
• It is located at the front of each hemisphere (brain’s cerebral cortex) and largest lobe.
 
• The central sulcus frontal lobe is separated from the parietal lobe.
 
• The vital role of the frontal lobe is decision making including self-management, Speech, and language, Comparing objects, memories, understanding, and reacting to feelings, behaviour, attention, etc.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/32105d7a8df20fd86d5ca62303343c526c7e323a9d92d2e1874cd5b14ddd2624.png] 

 
• The temporal lobe is located in the bottom section of the brain and sits close to the ear level within the skull.
 
• The vital functions are hearing, language recognization, speaking and understanding writing, memory acquisition, visual perception, etc.
 
• Therefore hearing is controlled by the temporal lobe.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• 
 
Parietal lobe

 
 
• Located behind the frontal lobe.
 
• Receive and transmit sensory information from the body and it is also connected to other parts of the brain.
 
• Deals with many sensations including touch, pressure, pain, heat, cold, etc
 
 
 
• 
 
Occipital lobe

 
 
• It is the smallest of the lobes, located at the back portion of the brain and below the occipital bone.
 
• The primary visual cortex, which is located in the occipital lobe, receives and interprets information from the retinas of the eyes.
 
• The occipital lobe deals with aspects of vision, including face recognition, movement, object recognition, colour determination, distance, depth perception.
